notes:
Inbound SMB lead via docs signup. CTO (Anika R.) and Head of Content (Marco) on kickoff call 2026-02-14. Primary ask: want to launch editorial-assistant MVP using Hosted API. Big concern: what do you store? how long? can authors opt out?

Key quotes / paraphrases: 
- "We cannot keep raw prompts tied to user emails for longer than 30 days without explicit consent." (CTO)
- "Authors will demand the ability to purge their drafts from the system." (Head of Content)

Technical notes from call: 
- Using public cloud preferred (AWS us-east). No private deployment for now.
- Expected volume: 5k-25k tokens/day to start; peak bursts during newsletter sends. Latency tolerance: ~300-500ms for interactive editor suggestions.
- Model preference: open or permissively licensed models OK; cost-sensitive. Will test 7B -> 13B variants.

Security asks: 
- Need written retention policy for logs and prompts (default retention, purge options, opt-out API).
- Audit logging for admin actions and ability to export logs for compliance.
- Data residency question: storage in US only.

Action items (AE/SE): 
- Send one-pager that outlines: default prompt/log retention windows (30 days default, 90 days available for paid tier), opt-out mechanism (per-user opt-out flag + purge endpoint), and how cached prefixes are handled.
- Provide security FAQ link + SOC2 summary. (attached drive link)
- Demo call to show how purge/retention works in Console (can be low-fi).

Notes style: shorthand, fragmented, follow-up items bolded in internal pipe: "follow-up: retention one-pager".
